page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i server family. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 4 physical cores, operating at 1.0 thread per core. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

The instance includes a bundled hardware accelerator consisting of one NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not feature any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile represents an entry-level GPU instance, balancing a dedicated accelerator with a modest CPU and memory allocation. This configuration is suitable for workloads such as low-concurrency GPU inference, video transcoding, lightweight machine learning model deployment, and general-purpose compute tasks that require hardware acceleration without massive memory or storage footprints.
